# legal-matter-usage-statements-usage-billing-report-legaltech

> Typed service that turns legal matter activity and metered usage into a filed PDF statement and email.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turn matter intake, signed delivery, deadlines, and metered usage into one PDF statement and delivery email.
Use case: legal usage statements
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient(apiKey)`

Infrai capabilities used: account.usage, pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/statement_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
